scope: All ten fixed nominal C1 endpoints; technical extras and preparation calls remain in their separate records. Provider wire captures only; gateway/native views are not added.
limits: Error codes and provider names here come from captured response bodies; this report does not separately assert HTTP status.
One provider call ID is counted once as failed; repeated identical error packets within it are deduplicated. Different error kinds within one call are diagnostic groups, not additional paid calls.
Unknown/unclassified responses are not zero errors or successful inference. Missing failed-call usage remains unavailable, not free.
A body identifying Crusoe establishes reported upstream-route attribution, not physical serving attestation. Timeouts without provider metadata cannot identify the exact failing component.
Endpoint causes, original source/Beads, native usage, timing and acceptance scores are unchanged. This is descriptive pilot infrastructure evidence, not a model-quality ranking.
